content: I adapt the evaluation protocol and stimuli of BIBREF1 , BIBREF2 and BIBREF3 to the bidirectional setting required by BERT, and evaluate the pre-trained BERT models (both the Large and the Base models). Surprisingly (at least to me), the out-of-the-box models (without any task-specific fine-tuning) perform very well on all the syntactic tasks.
